1: Chapter 1: Visitor on a Rainy Night
The rain in Qingshi had been falling for three solid days. Lin Xiaoyu's sister had left for the capital in spring, and since then she'd been running the little herbalist shop on her own.
After dark, she locked the doors and windows, counted the day's earnings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
Barely had she lain down when urgent knocking came from below, followed by a man's voice: "Is anyone there?"
A young man stood at the door, soaked through, with a blood-soaked bandage wrapped around his left arm. He said his name was Bai Yun and he was with the Azure Dragon Society.
"I need my wound dressed," Bai Yun said quietly. "I can pay—will three thousand five hundred coppers do?"
He drew a letter wrapped in oiled paper from his chest. "This letter must reach Qingfeng before May eighteenth."
As she bandaged him, he managed a wry smile. "If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a young woman's door in the middle of the night, she'd be jealous."
Lin Xiaoyu refused his money. "First thing tomorrow morning, I'll take you up the mountain."
2: Just as dawn broke, the two set out. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back, filled with dry rations, medicinal herbs, and an old umbrella.

Halfway up the mountain, they encountered an old woodcutter named Zhou Dashan. The old man set down his axe and lowered his voice, saying that three outsiders had been asking around at the town entrance yesterday evening about a wounded young man.
"Take the small road, Xiaoyu," said Zhou Dashan. "The main road isn't safe." Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The path was narrow and slippery. Lin Xiaoyu walked in front, each step steady and sure. Bai Yun followed behind, not saying a single word.

The rain stopped at noon, and the fog in the mountains slowly cleared, revealing the roof of Qingfeng Temple in the distance. A nun stood at the temple gate—her name was Zhao Qiuyue, and she was the temple's guest-welcoming nun.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, examined the red seal on the flap, and nodded. "The abbot has been waiting for this letter for two years."
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, "I owe you my life." Lin Xiaoyu smiled. "Then next time you come, help me fix the pharmacy roof." Bai Yun stayed at the temple.
Dusk fell. Lin Xiaoyu walked down the mountain alone. By the time she reached home, darkness had already descended. She lit the lamp and sat behind the counter for a long time.
